sentences.text: Patna High Court CWJC No.7930 of 2016(2) dt.16-01-2024 2.

This writ application has been filed for the following reliefs:-
"i) To hold and declare the entire acquisition proceeding bearing Case No.13/84-85 for 1.3725 acre of land in village-Muzaffara, Thana No.443 District- Begusarai as instituted by the respondent State in relation to the properties of the petitioners concern to have been lapsed in terms of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
ii) To hold and declare the entire acquisition proceeding bearing Case No.13/84-85 as instituted by the respondent State in relation to the properties of the petitioners concern to have been lapsed also in light of Section 11A of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 as no award has been made uptil now since passing of the notification of publication in the year 1985 and declaration in the year 1986.
iii) To hold and declare that in light of Section 17(3-A) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, taking of the possession of the property of the petitioners without tendering payment of 80 percentum of the compensation is illegal and therefore no possession in the eyes of law.
iv) To issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to provide the cost of acquisition as define under Section 3(i) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as the respondent State has already constructed the road on the acquired property of Patna High Court CWJC No.7930 of 2016(2) dt.16-01-2024 the petitioners without making any award and without payment of any compensation thereafter.

sentences.text: v) To issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to pass an award under the new Act on the basis of the current market value of the lands in question in light of the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and compensate the petitioners accordingly.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
vi) To issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to also award solatium as per Section 30 of the new Act,
interest @ 15% in light of Section 80 of the new Act read with Section 34 of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
vii) To any other relief or reliefs for which the petitioners is found to be entitled in the facts and circumstances of the case."
